                                                     \\\n        if (err__ != cudaSuccess) {                                                      \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error at %s:%d: %s\\n\", __FILE__, __LINE__,             \\\n                    cudaGetErrorString(err__));                                          \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                                \\\n        }                                                                                \\\n    } while (0)\n\nstruct Vec3 {\n    double x, y, z;\n    constexpr Vec3(const double x = 0, const double y = 0, const double z = 0) noexcept : x(x), y(y), z(z) {}\n};\n\nstruct Body {\n    Vec3 pos;\n    Vec3 vel;\n};\n\nvoid randomizeBodies(std::vector<Body>& bodies, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    for (auto& body : bodies) {\n        body.pos.x = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.pos.y = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.pos.z = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.vel.x = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.vel.y = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.vel.z = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n    }\n}\n\n// One CUDA thread owns one locally-assigned body. Force accumulation walks the\n// full (replicated) position array in index order 0..N-1, matching the inner\n// loop order of the original sequential computeForces() exactly.\n__global__ void nbodyStepKernel(const double* __restrict__ gx, const double* __restrict__ gy,\n                                 const double* __restrict__ gz, double* __restrict__ lx,\n                                 double* __restrict__ ly, double* __restrict__ lz,\n                                 double* __restrict__ lvx, double* __restrict__ lvy,\n                                 double* __restrict__ lvz, int N, int localN, int offset, double dt,\n                                 double softening) {\n    const int i = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (i >= localN) return;\n\n    const int gi = offset + i;\n    const double xi = gx[gi];\n    const double yi = gy[gi];\n    const double zi = gz[gi];\n\n    double Fx = 0.0, Fy = 0.0, Fz = 0.0;\n    for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {\n        const double dx = gx[j] - xi;\n        const double dy = gy[j] - yi;\n        const double dz = gz[j] - zi;\n        const double distSqr = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + softening;\n        const double invDist = 1.0 / sqrt(distSqr);\n        const double invDist3 = invDist * invDist * invDist;\n\n        Fx += dx * invDist3;\n        Fy += dy * invDist3;\n        Fz += dz * invDist3;\n    }\n\n    const double nvx = lvx[i] + dt * Fx;\n    const double nvy = lvy[i] + dt * Fy;\n    const double nvz = lvz[i] + dt * Fz;\n\n    lvx[i] = nvx;\n    lvy[i] = nvy;\n    lvz[i] = nvz;\n\n    lx[i] = xi + nvx * dt;\n    ly[i] = yi + nvy * dt;\n    lz[i] = zi + nvz * dt;\n}\n\ndouble computeTotalEnergy(const std::vector<Body>& bodies) {\n    double energy = 0.0;\n    const size_t n = bodies.size();\n\n    // Kinetic energy (assuming unit mass)\n#pragma omp parallel for reduction(+ : energy) schedule(static)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        const auto& body = bodies[i];\n        energy += 0.5 * (body.vel.x * body.vel.x + body.vel.y * body.vel.y + body.vel.z * body.vel.z);\n    }\n\n    // Potential energy (assuming unit mass for all bodies)\n#pragma omp parallel for reduction(+ : energy) schedule(dynamic, 64)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {\n            const double dx = bodies[j].pos.x - bodies[i].pos.x;\n            const double dy = bodies[j].pos.y - bodies[i].pos.y;\n            const double dz = bodies[j].pos.z - bodies[i].pos.z;\n            const double dist = std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING);\n            energy -= 1.0 / dist;\n        }\n    }\n\n    return energy;\n}\n\n// Validate that simulation produces finite, reasonable values\nbool validateSimulation(const std::vector<Body>& bodies) {\n    const size_t n = bodies.size();\n    int ok = 1;\n\n#pragma omp parallel for reduction(&& : ok) schedule(static)\n    for (size_t idx = 0; idx < n; ++idx) {\n        const auto& body = bodies[idx];\n        bool localOk = true;\n\n        // Check for NaN or Inf values\n        if (!std::isfinite(body.pos.x) || !std::isfinite(body.pos.y) || !std::isfinite(body.pos.z) ||\n            !std::isfinite(body.vel.x) || !std::isfinite(body.vel.y) || !std::isfinite(body.vel.z)) {\n            localOk = false;\n        }\n\n        // Check for extreme values (bodies shouldn't fly off to infinity)\n        const double maxPos = 1e6;\n        const double maxVel = 1e6;\n        if (std::abs(body.pos.x) > maxPos || std::abs(body.pos.y) > maxPos || std::abs(body.pos.z) > maxPos) {\n            localOk = false;\n        }\n        if (std::abs(body.vel.x) > maxVel || std::abs(body.vel.y) > maxVel || std::abs(body.vel.z) > maxVel) {\n            localOk = false;\n        }\n\n        ok = ok && (localOk ? 1 : 0);\n    }\n\n    if (!ok) {\n        printf(\"Validation failed: found NaN, Inf, or out-of-bounds value in body state\\n\");\n    }\n    return ok != 0;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of bodies (default: 1024)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -s <num>     Number of simulation steps (default: 10)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation (checks energy conservation)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &worldSize);\n\n    // Determine node-local rank so each MPI rank binds to a distinct GPU on its node.\n    MPI_Comm nodeComm;\n    MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, rank, MPI_INFO_NULL, &nodeComm);\n    int nodeRank = 0;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(nodeComm, &nodeRank);\n    MPI_Comm_free(&nodeComm);\n\n    int deviceCount = 0;\n    cudaGetDeviceCount(&deviceCount);\n    if (deviceCount <= 0) {\n        if (rank == 0) fprintf(stderr, \"No CUDA-capable devices found\\n\");\n        MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);\n    }\n    const int device = nodeRank % deviceCount;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaSetDevice(device));\n\n    int numBodies = 1024;\n    int numSteps = 10;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments (identical on every rank)\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == identical, fully deterministic initial condition set\n    // (cheap O(N) work) so no broadcast is required and semantics match the\n    // original sequential implementation exactly.\n    std::vector<Body> bodies(numBodies);\n    randomizeBodies(bodies);\n\n    // Static block decomposition of bodies across MPI ranks.\n    const int base = numBodies / worldSize;\n    const int rem = numBodies % worldSize;\n    std::vector<int> counts(worldSize), displs(worldSize);\n    for (int r = 0; r < worldSize; ++r) {\n        counts[r] = base + (r < rem ? 1 : 0);\n        displs[r] = r * base + std::min(r, rem);\n    }\n    const int localN = counts[rank];\n    const int offset = displs[rank];\n\n    // Replicated global position arrays (SoA), and this rank's local velocity slice.\n bodies, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    for (auto& body : bodies) {\n        body.pos.x = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        body.pos.y = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX)    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        double Fx = 0.0, Fy = 0.0, Fz = 0.0;\n        \n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            const double dx = bodies[j].pos.x - bodies[i].pos.x;\n            const double dy = bodies[j].pos.y - bodies[i].pos.y;\n            const double dz = bodies[j].pos.z - bodies[i].pos.z;\n            const double distSqr = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;\n            const double invDist = 1.0 / std::sqrt(distSqr);\n            const double invDist3 = invDist * invDist * invDist;\n            \n            Fx += dx * invDist3;\n            Fy += dy * invDist3;\n            Fz += dz * invDist3;\n        }\n        \n        bodies[i].vel.x += DT * Fx;\n        bodies[i].vel.y += DT * Fy;\n        bodies[i].vel.z += DT * Fz;\n    }\n}\n\nvoid integrateBodies(std::vector<Body>& bodies) {\n    for (auto& body : bodies) {\n        body.pos.x += body.vel.x * DT;\n        body.pos.y += body.vel.y * DT;\n        body.pos.z += body.vel.z * DT;\n    }\n}\n\ndouble computeTotalEnergy(const std::vector<Body>& bodies) {\n    double energy = 0.0;\n    const size_t n = bodies.size();\n    \n    // Kinetic energy (assuming unit mass)\n    for (const auto& body : bodies) {\n        energy += 0.5 * (body.vel.x * body.vel.x + \n                        body.vel.y * body.vel.y + \n                        body.vel.z * body.vel.z);\n    }\n    \n    // Potential energy (assuming unit mass for all bodies)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {\n            const double dx = bodies[j].pos.x - bodies[i].pos.x;\n            const double dy = bodies[j].pos.y - bodies[i].pos.y;\n            const double dz = bodies[j].pos.z - bodies[i].pos.z;\n            const double dist = std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING);\n            energy -= 1.0 / dist;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return energy;\n}\n\n// Validate that simulation produces finite, reasonable values\nbool validateSimulation(const std::vector<Body>& bodies) {\n    for (const auto& body : bodies) {\n        // Check for NaN or Inf values\n        if (!std::isfinite(body.pos.x) || maxVel) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: body velocity exceeds reasonable bounds\\n\");\n            return false;\n        }\n    }\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    int numBodies = 1024;\n    int numSteps = 10;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n    \n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            numBodies = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-s\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            numSteps = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if std::vector<Body> bodies(numBodies);\n    randomizeBodies(bodies);\n    \n    // Run simulation\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    \n    for (int step = 0; step < Summary of the implementation:\n\n**Architecture** (`nbody/nbody.cpp`, `nbody/CMakeLists.txt`):\n- **MPI**: bodies are statically decomposed across ranks; each rank owns a contiguous slice. Positions are replicated via `MPI_Allgatherv` each step (in-place, since each rank's own segment is already correct); final velocities are gathered to rank 0 with `MPI_Gatherv` for reporting.\n- **CUDA**: each MPI rank binds to one GPU (`nodeRank % deviceCount`, using `MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED)` for correct multi-node GPU assignment). A single kernel computes forces and integrates each rank's local bodies against the full replicated position array, preserving the original sequential summation order (loop `j = 0..N-1`) so per-body results stay numerically consistent with the original algorithm.\n- **OpenMP**: parallelizes host-side independent work — SoA packing/unpacking, final result reconstruction, `computeTotalEnergy`, and `validateSimulation`.\n- The file is compiled as CUDA via `set_source_files_properties(...
